title: zone.remove v1 parameters
description: Remove a zone (A2). Executes as cmd.map.geofence.{id}.remove; the geofence service also accepts the verb delete. Parameters of an ActionRequest (onemind-xr docs/contracts/asset-command.md section 6.1); the policy service copies them into the data of cmd.map.geofence.{id}.{verb} after approval and the geofence service (services/geofence) applies them to KV geofences. Unknown fields are refused.
